task.description:
Design and write tests for DSL-04 — Supported types. Read the requirement at docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md (around line 1924) and the design at src/design/expr-types.md. Then explore the existing implementation at src/expr/ast.zig and src/expr/mod.zig to understand the Value type, TypeTag, literal parsing, and evaluate() implementation.

Write test spec at tests/specs/DSL-04.md covering:
1. Each of the 6 types has a correct Zig representation (null, bool, int64, float64, string, timestamp)
2. Literal forms parse correctly for: null, true/false, integers, floats, strings
3. Round-trip: parse -> evaluate -> correct Value for each literal type
4. Unsupported types produce structured parse errors
5. typeOf() helper returns correct TypeTag for each Value variant
6. Value construction helpers (valueNull, valueBool, valueInt, valueFloat, valueStr, valueTs) produce correct values

Also write test code implementing these tests as Zig test blocks (no mocks, no stubs — per DIRECTIVE T-1 the tests must be real). Integrate the tests into the existing test structure under src/expr/.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/DSL-04.md exists with comprehensive test spec
Zig test code covers all acceptance criteria from the requirement
zig build test exits 0 with new tests passing
No mocks or stubs — real types only
No error.SkipZigTest on MUST coverage tests
Each type's literal round-trip is verified

result.summary: Test spec and Zig test code for DSL-04 (Supported types). Created tests/specs/DSL-04.md with 16 test cases. Enhanced existing round-trip test with payload verification, added timestamp type verification test, and added integer overflow error test. All 17 DSL-04 test blocks pass with zig build test exiting 0.
